bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="deploy/state/startless-pr71-stage"
test -s "$stage/gaybbs.mjs"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
oldimage="sha256:4d4ab3395ce4c250dc40ca179bbac7598d149288cac2381b54e11e7a719b6f5c"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$oldimage"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)" = "$oldimage"
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = ae1efae7152d3ae8c161e1a06bfb6f0bc6278e44483eeeaf6ad20432b44e5443
test ! -e deploy/state/startless-pr71-deploy-20261122.json
backup="gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:before-startless-pr71-20261122"
new="gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-pr71-20261122"
docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local "$backup"
printf 'FROM %s\nCOPY gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs\n' "$backup" > "$stage/Dockerfile"
docker build --no-cache -q -t "$new" -f "$stage/Dockerfile" "$stage" >/dev/null
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$new" --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null
expected="$(sha256sum "$stage/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
newimage="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$new")"
test "$newimage" != "$oldimage"
docker image tag "$new" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
if ! docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/dev/null; then
 docker image tag "$backup" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/dev/null
 exit 70
fi
if test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" != true || test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" != "$newimage" || test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$expected"; then
 docker image tag "$backup" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml up -d --no-deps --no-build gaybbs >/dev/null
 exit 71
fi
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("/app/gaybbs.mjs","utf8");if(!s.includes("STARTLESS_REPEATED_START_LINK_FORBIDDEN")||!s.includes("gdm:"))process.exit(2)' 
printf '{"state":"VERIFIED","scope":"compiled public-navigation adapter only","old_image":"%s","new_image":"%s","new_bundle_sha256":"%s","userbot_service":"unchanged"}\n' "$oldimage" "$newimage" "$expected" > deploy/state/startless-pr71-deploy-20261122.json
echo "STARTLESS_BOT_RUNTIME_PATCH_DEPLOY_VERIFIED=PASS"
